So I got into a quality nature versus nurture debate on another site and somehow my posts were deleted, but I wasted a great deal of time on them so I am moving them here where I know they are safe. Essentially the debate was that mass shooters are overwhelmingly male because we are socialized with concepts of masculinity. I contend that the aggression and propensity to commit violence has more to do with the hard wiring of a male. As racism is an epidemic shared by genders as are the other factors we associated with the people that commit these atrocities and yet men more often women not act out.

I would like to preface this post by acknowledging socialized masculinity ("pink is for girls," "suits are for boys" etc.) exists as does biological masculinity ("the trophy hunter" mentality, the protector, or the myriad of other traits we share with our animal brothers). The socialized components have changed numerous times in our past in nigh cyclical fashion. Engaging in homosexual intercourse has been praised (src. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Homosexuality_in_ancient_Greece)) in social masculinity in ancient Greece and condemned in western culture's social masculinity. We wore skirts and then condemned them. Our value systems have changed drastically in immeasurable ways, but through all of them our biological concepts of masculinity have been the same. This is okay because it is why we are alive today rather than victimized by our inept genetics.

You are probably asking what this has to do with the fact men comprise of the majority of mass shooters. Mass shooters and violent criminals will always be majority male because we have a biological composition that makes us react to things (like social change, abuse, shame) more aggressively. Women and men throughout history have had an equal share in the development of society, formation of socialized roles, the triumphs and the pitfalls of mankind.

Before I get smited with the "women didn't have the right to vote" stuff I ask that you please defer your studies to anti-suffragism. Sadly women played a role as did men in denying the deserved liberties to their deserving counterparts. Having equal numbers (something that black Americans tragically did not have to attain their foothold) in society and being men's equals mean that the burden of gender roles is shared. Lest you believe women to be inferior to men as the population ratio is identical (something oppressed groups like minorities, gays, and unpopular faiths do/did not have) then your conclusion must be similar.

Let me break this down for people piece by piece as to why men are more aggressive. I want to start with the amygdala. When we look at a males amygdala we find that it is larger than a females. This is because the amygdala is the part of the brain that processes fear and triggers a reaction. The male amygdala also has testosterone receptors that heighten responses in crisis. (Source: http://languagelog.ldc.upenn.edu/myl/ldc/llog/Brizendine/Hamann2005.pdf))

Funny I should end that with testosterone because the next piece of my case study is just that. When we examine testosterone we find that there is a direct correlation to male violence and testosterone. In a case study among 692 prison inmates it was discovered that there was a direct correlation in the testosterone levels and the violence of the criminal at hand. (src. http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/019188699400177T)) As correlation doesn't necessarily mean causation I continued analysis on testosterone to examine more deeply and what I found is that psych study (Alvarez & Bachman, 2008) found that violent behavior is directly linked to testosterone levels in animals as well as humans. Still we are able to produce evidence that does indicate that you can have high testosterone and not be violent. Propensity does not equal absolute result.

Moving on from testosterone we find that our love molecule is different. Oxytocin in males is lower because it is blocked by testosterone. The end result of this is lower levels of empathy. Our lower oxytocin means less seratonin, which is the feel good neurotransmitter associated with anxiety reduction and positive moods. (src. http://www.amazon.com/The-Moral-Molecule-Source-Prosperity/dp/B0081X5SWI))

Now let us continue down the list of our biological factors in our aggression stress induced activation of cortisol. This weird little devil can be triggered in greater quantities to a female if you were to say you didn't want to be around her, but it exists in a higher quantity in males. What does this mean? It means that the hypothalamic–pituitary–adrenal axis can be reprogrammed in a disadvantageous way for men when exposed to stress early in life. (src. http://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/15361587)) The simplified version of this is that men are much more likely to be rewired neurologically than women are.

Finally, I'd like to conclude the biology lesson with monoamine oxidase also known as the warrior gene. This gene is linked to the x chromosome, which women have two of and men only one. This lovely gene breaks down seratonin (the feel good stuff) and norepinephrine (where your blood pressure goes to rise). For men the one x chromosome means significantly less buffer to prevent the corruption of this system. Corruption of this system increases the likelihood of violence(src. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monoamine_oxidase_A))

I would like to close with a statistic that was presented by my friend using his words "2013 there were 480,360 violent arrests recorded by the FBI Crime statistics. The US population in 2013 is 316.5 million. Lets assume half the population is male (108 million). assuming all violent crimes were done by male in that year, the percentage of males who did violent crimes is .44%." We need to remember that when we talk about violent tendencies we are referring to outliers. Outliers (especially in this tiny of a quantity) should not indict philosophies/gender/race or any other composition of a non harmful human. Understanding that men are more at risk for the state of mental disease that can do these horrible crimes means that we need to find new ways to identify warning signs and help treat the outliers before they escalate their aggression. Emasculation as a solution only serves to shame men, which will precipitate a rise in these numbers.
